title: Customer Success Engineer - CSE / Sr. CSE
description:
### **About ArmorCode**

ArmorCode delivers the Agentic Control Plane for Unified Exposure Management. The ArmorCode platform ingests findings from 400+ security tools, correlates them with business context in the Context Risk Graph, and puts Anya AI agents to work prioritizing, routing, and verifying fixes. Enterprises including Visa, PayPal, Volvo Group, and Johnson Controls use ArmorCode to remediate at machine speed and reduce risk fast.

Processing over 400 billion findings a year across hundreds of native integrations, ArmorCode unifies, prioritizes, and drives remediation across applications, cloud, code, infrastructure, and AI. Powered by Anya, the industry's first agentic AI framework for enterprise security, ArmorCode is trusted by global enterprises to reduce exposure and adopt AI and modern software practices with confidence, without replacing existing tools or forcing vendor consolidation.

ArmorCoders believe in five core values: **Hungry. Humble. Hardworking. Honest. Human.** Our organization is powered by exceptional professionals who bring fresh ideas and passion to their roles, believing that nothing is beyond reach when our "5H" principles are applied. In their work and professional relationships, ArmorCoders commit to excellence and experiences that leave an impression.

### 

### **About the Role**

Our Customer Success Engineers play an important role in onboarding new customers and ensuring successful adoption of the platform. Together with the Customer Success Manager, you will ensure a smooth onboarding process for the technical implementation of the ArmorCode SaaS platform. You will work closely with Product Management and Engineering to make sure feature requests are developed to meet customer use cases. You will also use AI hands-on in your day-to-day work, building automations and AI-assisted workflows that make onboarding and integrations faster, more repeatable, and more consistent across customers.

  

### **What You'll Own**

**Strategic Customer Engagement**

* Act as a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams, providing feedback to accelerate and prioritize delivery.
* Identify technical and business requirements, aligning solutions with customer needs to drive value and exceed expectations.
* Serve as the main point of contact throughout the customer journey, working with the CSM on a success plan with clear outcomes and keeping communication effective across executives, business owners, and operational teams.

**Technical Implementation and Integration**

* Accelerate time to value (TTV) through short deployments, working with the Development team to find the best setup for each customer's integration needs.
* Oversee and support technical implementation tasks for new customers.
* Build and maintain scripts and automations (Python, APIs, and LLM-assisted workflows) that make onboarding, integration setup, and configuration validation repeatable.
* Use AI tools to speed up implementation work, such as mapping customer tool landscapes to integrations, drafting implementation plans, and generating configuration and API scripts, and review everything before it reaches a customer.

**Product Adoption and Insights**

* Drive adoption of our product and solutions, using data to give 360-degree insight into current status and progress, from baseline customers to enterprise upsells.
* Build relationships within assigned customers to support and execute their strategy and solutions roadmap.
* Identify risks early, build and execute "get well" plans, and define critical success factors and success metrics.
* Use AI-assisted analysis of usage and onboarding data to spot adoption gaps and stalled deployments early, and turn them into specific next steps.

**AI Enablement**

* Help customers adopt and get value from the platform's AI-driven capabilities, and bring their feedback to Product and Engineering.
* Build reusable assets (prompt libraries, scripts, onboarding templates, playbooks) and share them so the whole Customer Success team gets faster.

  

**Exceptional Customer Experience**

* Deliver an exceptional customer experience through proactive communication, effective use of internal resources, and customer enablement resources that support business goals.

**Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Liaise between product management, engineering, marketing, and the customer, communicating product and strategic roadmaps and generating insights that influence company and customer action.

**Training and Knowledge Management**

* Drive training initiatives, maintain a training record, and keep your own knowledge current.
* Participate in answering level one support questions and contribute to building and updating the knowledge base for internal and external use.
* Use AI to accelerate drafting of implementation guides and enablement content, with human review for accuracy.

**Data Management and Hygiene**

* Keep customer data up to date across all platforms, and regularly verify the hygiene of new and existing data so it stays usable.

  

### **Who you are**

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of experience in a technical customer-facing role such as Customer Success Engineer, Solutions Engineer, Sales Engineer, Implementation Engineer, or similar, with a cybersecurity background.
* Knowledge of the mission and practices of Customer Success functions.
* Experience with Software as a Service (SaaS), preferably at a security software company.
* Python scripting experience, including using APIs for workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience using LLMs or generative AI tools in technical work such as scripting, automation, integration work, or technical documentation, including effective prompting.
* Practical judgment about AI limits: you validate outputs, recognize hallucinations, and protect customer and confidential data when using AI tools.
* Knowledge of Single Sign-on (SSO), Okta, and similar identity providers.
* Experience in technical troubleshooting (product, software, etc.).
* Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, a coding bootcamp, or equivalent work experience is a strong plus.
* CISSP, CISM, OSCP, or PMP is a strong plus.
* Plus: experience building automations that call LLM APIs, or working with agentic or workflow tools.

**Skills**

* Excellent communication skills and enjoyment in working directly with customers.
* Strong problem solver who thrives in an unstructured environment.
* Ability to explain technical concepts and recommendations clearly to customers.
* Team player who builds collaborative relationships with other departments.
* Organized in tracking customer requests.
* Ownership of the post-sales process, including kick-off, launch, health checks, and renewal/upsell.
* AI-first habits: you reach for automation and AI first on repetitive implementation and onboarding work, and you share what works.

**Behavioural Skills**

* Customer-centric approach and solution selling
* Problem-solving
* Proactive customer engagement
* Cross-functional collaboration
* Excellent communication

  

### **Why You Will Love It**

* Career Growth Opportunities: We believe in promoting from within and provide career progression paths, enabling our employees to advance in their careers
* Work-Life Balance: We understand the importance of a healthy work-life balance, offering flexible hours and remote work options to promote a sustainable lifestyle
* Collaborative Environment: Our company fosters a collaborative and inclusive workplace culture, where employees can collaborate and learn from each other's experiences
* Employee Recognition: We value and recognize the contributions of our team members through awards, employee of the month programs, and other forms of acknowledgment.
* Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salaries and performance-based bonuses, recognizing and rewarding the hard work and dedication of our team
* Comprehensive Benefits: Our benefits package includes health insurance for employees and dependents, to support the overall well-being of our employees. We encourage learning and skilling, and aid our employees to continuously upskill themselves.
* Diversity and Inclusion: We are committed to diversity and inclusion, striving to create an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered

Join ArmorCode and lead the charge in reducing signal fatigue, prioritizing risk and streamlining key cybersecurity workflows. Apply today to be part of a close-knit team, dedicated to democratizing software security and helping build the safest software possible.

  

### **Equal Opportunity**

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or any other legally protected category. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply and will receive consideration for employment regardless of their background or characteristics. We are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.

title: Solutions Architect | India
description:
#### **Why Cast AI?**

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don't. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

**Global team, diverse perspectives**  
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

**Unicorn momentum**  
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

**Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.**

#### **About this role:**

We are hiring a Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team and support strategic customers across APAC.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role for someone with strong Kubernetes, SRE and DevOps experience. You will work alongside Technical Account Managers and Client Partners, becoming the escalation point when a customer conversation requires deeper technical expertise, stronger architecture guidance or support with a complex production issue.

You will work directly with customers to understand their Kubernetes environment, diagnose technical challenges, guide them towards the right Cast AI solution and help them realise more value from the platform. You will also identify and support expansion opportunities, including positioning Omni where it can solve a meaningful customer problem.

This is not a traditional post-sales support role. You need to be comfortable in front of senior technical stakeholders, able to explain complex Kubernetes topics clearly and willing to travel to customer sites when needed.

The role covers APAC.

#### **Requirements:**

* Six to twelve years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Solutions Engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience. You need to understand how clusters, workloads, networking, scaling and resource management operate in production.
* Meaningful prior experience as an SRE or DevOps Engineer. This is essential. Candidates without a real operational background are unlikely to succeed in the technical interview or the role.
* Experience troubleshooting production incidents, including diagnosing root cause, resolving the issue and implementing improvements afterwards.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native tooling.
* Able to communicate technical concepts in a logical, clear and customer-friendly way.
* Comfortable speaking with engineering leaders, platform teams, SREs, DevOps teams and senior technical stakeholders.
* Interested in a customer-facing role, whether you already work with customers or want to move from a deeply technical role into one.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, less structured environment where ownership and initiative matter.
* Willing to travel to customer locations for a few days per month.

#### **Responsibilities****:**

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic and complex customer conversations.
* Partner with Technical Account Managers on customer onboarding, adoption, technical risk and platform value.
* Work with Client Partners to identify and support expansion opportunities within existing customers.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand their Kubernetes architecture, workloads, operational challenges and priorities.
* Advise customers on Kubernetes reliability, efficiency, scaling and platform best practices.
* Help customers diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving Kubernetes clusters, workloads, resource management, networking or platform reliability.
* Represent Cast AI in customer meetings, technical workshops and occasional on-site visits across APAC.
* Support the commercial adoption of Omni by connecting product capabilities to genuine customer needs.
* Share recurring customer feedback, technical blockers and product opportunities with Product and Engineering teams.
* Work closely with a team of SREs and cloud infrastructure specialists within Customer Success.

#### **What's in it for you?**

* Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
* Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology.
* Equity options.
* Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
* Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.
* Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
* Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
* Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
* Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

#### **Hiring process**

* Screening call with Recruiter
* Hiring Manager interview
* 1-2 additional interviews based on the role
* Culture Check interview with an executive

* *As part of our standard hiring process, we would like to inform you that a background check may be conducted at the final stage of recruitment through our third-party provider, Checkr.*

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging
* Promote best practices in DevOps, continuous deployment, and Agile methodologies to enhance development efficiency and product quality
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration
* Engage with external developers and partners to expand the ecosystem of integrations available through the Docusign App Center

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of software development and management experience across multiple languages/frameworks (or equivalent)
* 5+ years of hands-on coding or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading software teams of 5+ people or equivalent
* Proven track record in building solutions that consume and expose APIs/web services
* Experience in SaaS or Cloud environments

**Preferred**

* Expertise with high-availability (99.99%+) distributed systems
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies
* Curiosity and adaptability in learning new tech stacks
* Experience building and scaling platform components for app marketplaces or similar ecosystems
* Prior involvement in designing secure, reliable integrations with third-party apps or services
* Experience in integrating with 3rd party enterprise systems
* Experience in building enterprise software and platforms

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

title: Senior Engineer - MDM
description:
**Presidio, Where Teamwork and Innovation Shape the Future**  
At Presidio, we're at the forefront of a global technology revolution, transforming industries through cutting-edge digital solutions and next-generation AI. We empower businesses - and their internal customers - to achieve more through innovation, automation, and intelligent insights.

**The Role**

The Mobile Device Management (MDM) Engineer is responsible for monitoring, managing and supporting customer mobile device environments using the NinjaOne platform under the guidance of the MDM Team Lead. This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned incidents and service requests, maintaining ownership through resolution while ensuring compliance with contracted SLAs.  
  
The ideal candidate is customer focused, technically skilled and thrives in a fast paced operations environment. This position requires shift flexibility, including participation in rotating on call schedules and the ability to work varying shifts as business needs evolve.  
  
The MDM Engineer will regularly collaborate with customers, peers, vendors and leadership through phone, email, chat, video conferencing and ticketing systems such as ServiceNow to ensure timely and effective issue resolution.

##### **Key Responsibilities**

* Monitor and manage enrolled mobile devices across iOS, Android and Windows platforms using the NinjaOne MDM platform.
* Troubleshoot mobile device enrollment, connectivity, policy compliance and application delivery issues using NinjaOne and remote support tools.
* Manage incidents, requests and changes through ServiceNow while documenting troubleshooting activities and customer communications.
* Take ownership of assigned tickets and drive issues through to resolution or appropriate escalation.
* Administer device configuration profiles, security policies and compliance baselines within NinjaOne to enforce organizational standards across managed endpoints.
* Manage application deployment, updates and removal across mobile device fleets using NinjaOne software management capabilities.
* Support device lifecycle activities including enrollment, onboarding, offboarding and remote wipe for lost or decommissioned devices.
* Communicate effectively with customers, peers, management and cross functional engineering teams regarding incidents, outages and change activities.
* Participate in an on call rotation to provide emergency support coverage when required.
* Troubleshoot production issues and coordinate with NinjaOne support or third party vendors as necessary.
* Contribute to the creation and maintenance of technical documentation, operational procedures and knowledge base articles.
* Recommend process improvements and identify operational risks or areas of concern to management.
* Continue developing technical expertise across additional MDM and endpoint management technologies as business needs evolve.
* Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

#### **Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work and/or military experience.
* 2+ years of experience working in a Network Operations Center (NOC), Managed Services or IT Operations environment.
* 2+ years of hands on experience administering or supporting a Mobile Device Management platform in a production environment.
* Hands on experience with NinjaOne MDM including device enrollment, policy configuration, software deployment and compliance monitoring.

Lead post‑migration validation checks and hypercare support for device cohorts; reduce repeat incidents through root cause removal and runbook improvements.

Your sharp insights and discerning judgement will empower them to make informed decisions that drive their organizations towards unprecedented heights.
  
  
Our consultants are restless for innovation. Apply today to join our dynamic team that has a host of exciting projects and customers waiting for you to work with them to solve complex transformation puzzles through technology.

As an Application Consultant at Kyndryl you will join the Kyndryl Consultant Profession, working with other Kyndryl Consultants, Architects, Project Managers, and cross-functional Technical Subject Matter Experts – presenting unlimited opportunities with unmatched support through our investment in your learning, training, and career growth.

* Strong PowerShell and macOS scripting/automation skills.
* Experience troubleshooting device enrollment and migration issues.
* Experience with runbook-based 24x7 migration/factory operations, shift handovers, and documentation.
Strong stakeholder communication, troubleshooting, and ownership skills.  

  

**Preferred Skills & Experienc** e

* Knowledge of Conditional Access and Microsoft device security controls.
* Microsoft certifications such as MD-102, MS-102, or SC-300.
* Experience with global/remote user migrations.
Understanding of ITIL incident, problem, and change management.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.
  
  
From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.
  
  
We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  
  
We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.
